name: Corporate Tic Tac Toe
description: Run a tic tac toe tournament for your team in minutes. Share one link, players join on their own phone with just a name. Players never pay. Software only.

mainEntity.name: How do I set up a game?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the free AI assistant (the easiest way): tell it what you want and your draft is ready in minutes. Or set it up yourself in the organizer console. Building and publishing are free.

mainEntity.name: Do players pay or install anything?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Players never pay and there is no app to download. They open your link and type a display name. Nothing else is asked.

No. Players never pay and never stake money. There are no cash prizes and no betting. Any gift is supplied by the organizer, outside the product. Corporate Tic Tac Toe is software only. We never hold or pay prize money.

The software only. The bracket, the clocks and every result follow one sealed random seed and the same rules on every player's phone; our server only stores and passes on the moves. No person, including the organizer and us, can change a draw or a result. Cheating is very hard.
Through the link or the 6-digit code we send to your e-mail. There is no password to remember.

mainEntity.name: Can people in other countries play?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Anyone with the link can play on their own phone, in any country.
